name: Handyman, plumber & electrician (category guide)
summary: HDB town-council term rates vs condo MCST rules — PUB-licensed plumbing, EMA-licensed electrical work, and the cheap WhatsApp quote that balloons on-site.
body: askSingapore’s standing advice for HDB: check your town council’s published handyman / sanitary / electrical term-contractor rates before googling ‘24hr plumber’ — contracted call-out fees are often lower and clearer. Condo / landed tenants usually go through the managing agent or landlord for common-property issues; private interiors still need licensed trades. PUB expects licensed plumbers for regulated plumbing works — verify on PUB’s homeowner plumbing pages rather than trusting a Facebook number. Electrical installations and modifications should sit with EMA-licensed electrical workers / licensed electrical workers (LEW) for the job class; frequent breaker trips need root-cause diagnosis, not a silent MCB swap. Classic forum failure mode: a too-cheap call-out that ‘discovers’ heavy equipment fees once on site — get a written scope, ask what triggers extras, and keep a second quote. Lease responsibility: landlord usually owns structure / water heater / wiring faults present at move-in; tenant misuse is on you — photograph and email before paying. Pair with aircon and pest category guides for adjacent home vendors. This is a category guide, not a ranked contractor list.
whenToEngage: HDB choke / trip — want town-council rate card first
Quoted 24hr call-out looks too cheap or extras unclear
Condo MA vs tenant responsibility for a leak is disputed
